title: Sr Manager Manufacturing Operations
text:
It's exciting to work for a company that makes the world measurably better.
 
 
We're committed to bringing safety, quality, and customer focus to the business of advanced ceramics manufacturing.
 
 
**Job Title**
Sr Manager Manufacturing Operations
 
 
As the Senior Manager, Manufacturing Operations you will be the senior production leader for the Oak Ridge Plant manufacturing execution, responsible for translating site priorities and customer requirements into safe, reliable manufacturing results. You will lead all production operations through a period of significant growth and increasing customer demand, with accountability for safety, quality, delivery, productivity, capacity utilization, and workforce performance.
 
 
As a leader, you will create and drives urgency, clarity, and accountability across the manufacturing organization. You will lead through production managers and supervisors, partners across functions to remove barriers, and represents the plant on customer calls related to production performance, capacity, delivery, and recovery plans. Overall site strategy, P&L ownership, capital allocation, and leadership of non-production functions remain with senior plant/regional leadership.
 
 
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Lead production execution across the Oak Ridge manufacturing operation, establishing clear priorities and delivering safety, quality, output, delivery, productivity, and workforce objectives.
* Lead, coach, and develop production managers, supervisors, and frontline teams; set clear expectations, reinforce accountability, and build leadership capability for continued growth.
* Create a visible and engaging leadership presence on the manufacturing floor, connecting employees to customer commitments, business priorities, and daily performance expectations.
* Establish disciplined daily management systems, operating rhythms, performance metrics, and escalation processes that enable teams to identify issues early and respond with urgency.
* Identify and remove constraints across labor, equipment, process flow, materials, maintenance, quality, and manufacturing systems to improve throughput and capacity utilization.
* Partner with Planning, Supply Chain, Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, Human Resources, Finance, and Commercial teams to align resources, resolve barriers, and deliver production commitments.
* Represent the plant on customer calls and internal operating reviews, partnering with Commercial, Planning, Quality, and other teams to communicate production status, risks, recovery actions, and commitments.
* Lead the manufacturing response to customer-impacting issues, ensuring timely containment, clear communication, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and sustainable resolution.
* Use production, labor, maintenance, yield, quality, capacity, and delivery data to identify trends, prioritize actions, and drive measurable improvement.
* Champion Lean, Theory of Constraints, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement to reduce waste and variation, improve flow, and strengthen operational capability.
* Support approved equipment installations, capacity expansions, and manufacturing-readiness activities required to meet current and future demand.
* Ensure production activities comply with safety, environmental, quality, regulatory, and company requirements, reinforcing that safety and quality are never compromised.

**Job Requirements:**
**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Business, or a related field; equivalent relevant manufacturing leadership experience may be considered.
* At least 7 years of progressive manufacturing or operations experience, including significant responsibility for leading managers, supervisors, or large production teams.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing through growth, capacity expansion, operational transformation, or substantial increases in customer demand.
* Proven results improving throughput, delivery, productivity, quality, capacity utilization, and operational stability.
* Experience applying Lean, Theory of Constraints, Six Sigma, or other structured continuous improvement and problem-solving methods.
* Experience in complex, high-precision manufacturing such as advanced materials, ceramics, semiconductor, electronics, aerospace, or medical devices is preferred.

**Functional/Technical Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:**

* Visible, decisive leadership style that creates alignment, urgency, engagement, and accountability.
* Ability to lead through other leaders and strengthen the performance of a multi-layer manufacturing organization.
* Strong understanding of production planning, capacity management, equipment utilization, labor productivity, yield, quality, delivery, and manufacturing cost.
* Ability to influence across functions and resolve complex operational barriers without direct authority over partner teams.
* Executive-level communication skills and the credibility to represent manufacturing with customers, frontline employees, technical teams, and senior leaders.
* Composure and sound judgment during operational pressure, changing priorities, and customer escalations.
* Business acumen to connect manufacturing performance with customer outcomes, revenue delivery, and sustainable growth.
* Learning agility and leadership potential to progress toward broader plant leadership responsibility.

Why This Role Matters
 
 
Oak Ridge is entering an important phase of growth. This role provides the opportunity to shape how the manufacturing organization scales, strengthen leadership capability, improve customer performance, and build the operating discipline needed for sustained success. The position offers significant exposure to senior manufacturing leadership and an opportunity to develop toward broader plant leadership responsibilities.

If you like working for a company that makes a real difference in the world, you'll enjoy your career with us!
